column1: # p428 · 2026-10-25 · THE BRANCH-ALIAS PROBE.  `gate-grant-path-online` answers "does this path resolve?" with an HTTP 200.
# This probe shows the 200 cannot answer the BRANCH half of the contract: GitHub serves the default branch under the legacy name `master`.
# Population: every distinct address carrying a `/(blob|tree|raw)/master` path anywhere under agents/ repos/ verticals/ intel/ compose/ README.md.
# 🔴 SCOPE NOTE, because p428's own first measurement got this wrong: that sweep is RECURSIVE and most of these citations live in
# `compose/code/**` — VENDORED COPIES OF OTHER PROJECTS' READMEs.  They are what UPSTREAM publishes, not what this base publishes.
# This base's own live shelves carry only 8 ref-asserting citations and ZERO alias-only defects (see `make branch-alias-census`).
# verdict: HAS-MASTER = the branch really exists.  NO-MASTER = it does not, and `raw.../master/` returns 200 anyway.
# ── THE 200-CHECK, RUN AGAINST THE 15 NO-MASTER ADDRESSES (README.md, 2026-10-25):
# AnubisLMS/Anubis master=200 main=200 | codemirror/codemirror.next 200/200 | digitalbazaar/bedrock 200/200 | dini-ag-kim/schulfaecher 200/200
# observablehq/stdlib 200/200 | preactjs/preact 200/200 | sveltejs/kit 200/200 | overhangio/tutor 404/404 (no README.md at all — a missing FILE, not a branch result)
# → 14 of the 14 testable `master`-less addresses return 200 under a branch that does not exist.
# ── THE MECHANISM, ISOLATED BY MEASUREMENT RATHER THAN ASSUMED.  On two independent main-only repositories
# (falkenslab/miyagi, microsoft/ML-For-Beginners) the probe asked for six other plausible branch names:
# trunk=404  develop=404  dev=404  default=404  release=404  stable=404  — while master=200 and HEAD=200.
# So `master` is specifically aliased; it is not a general "serve the default branch" fallback.
# ── AND THE ALIAS IS ONE-DIRECTIONAL.  HyNuwa/UniMCP's live branch is `master`; `raw.../UniMCP/main/LICENSE` returns 404.
# openeducat/openeducat_erp has 18 branches (`master` plus 2.0 … 20.0) and no `main`; `/main/LICENSE` 404s, `/master/LICENSE` 200s.
# The error is therefore silent in exactly one direction — the direction a path written from habit takes.
# ── BYTE-LEVEL CONFIRMATION that the alias serves the default branch rather than some other tree:
# falkenslab/miyagi `/master/package.json` and `/main/package.json` are both 1 123 B with sha256_12 4350dcad89c6.
# ── 1EdTech/spec-central answered `ls-remote` with a CREDENTIAL PROMPT while the control `moodle/moodle` resolved anonymously.
# Under p293 that is a MEASUREMENT (private or gone), and the branch question for it is UNDEFINED — the grader refuses a verdict rather than guessing.
